presets.title: 4 Choirs
presets.description: Layered human and synthetic voices arranged for the current number of people.

presets.title: All Strings
presets.description: A small string section that grows from solo cello into quartet voicing.

presets.title: Synth Pop
presets.description: Bright bass, strings, lead and keys with clean mid-tempo pulse.

presets.title: Brass Band
presets.description: Bold brass voicings, from solo trumpet to full low-and-high band.

presets.title: Dream Pads
presets.description: Soft atmospheric pads for floating, low-pressure harmonic playing.

presets.title: Orchestra
presets.description: A compact orchestral palette with winds, strings and horn.

presets.title: Rock Band
presets.description: Bass, guitars and organ with a direct energetic beat.

presets.title: Ambient
presets.description: Slow evolving textures with soundtrack and halo pads.

presets.title: Samba
presets.description: Bright melodic percussion and nylon guitar with lively syncopation.

presets.title: Techno
presets.description: Fast synthetic bass, square lead and tight electronic percussion.

presets.title: Jungle
presets.description: Fast bass and sharp leads with busier rolling breaks.

presets.title: Sound FX
presets.description: Atmospheres, echoes and environmental effects for playful texture.

presets.title: Hip-Hop
presets.description: 90 BPM groove with 25% swing, steady loop, shuffles, occasional bridges and breakouts.

presets.title: Reggae
presets.description: Laid-back bass, organ and guitar skank with a deep swinging pulse.

presets.title: Jazz Club
presets.description: Upright bass, electric piano, muted brass and clean guitar.

presets.title: Chiptune
presets.description: Square and saw leads with bright synthetic bass.

presets.title: K-Pop
presets.description: Glossy pop energy with punchy bass, bright keys, vocal lead and sparkling synth colour.

presets.title: Outer Space
presets.description: Wide sci-fi textures, crystals and halo pads for floating cosmic improvisation.

presets.title: Spooky
presets.description: Haunted organ, bells, choir and tremolo strings with uneasy minor movement.

presets.title: Disco
presets.description: Dancefloor bass, clavinet, strings and brass with a bright steady pulse.

presets.title: Cyberpunk
presets.description: Dark synthetic bass, metallic pads and aggressive leads for neon dystopia.

presets.title: Medieval
presets.description: Ancient plucked and pipe-like colours for courtly, modal ensemble play.

presets.title: Underwater
presets.description: Soft bottles, pads and seashore textures with a slow liquid pulse.

presets.title: Cartoon Chase
presets.description: Fast, bouncy comic energy with xylophone, whistle and slapstick percussion colours.

presets.title: Jazz Ensemble
presets.description: Electric piano, upright bass and horns over triplet ride swing.

presets.title: Blues Ensemble
presets.description: Guitar and harmonica with a 12/8 shuffle; swing is already in the rhythm.

presets.title: Classical piano Ensemble
presets.description: Piano-led chamber voices with an even, quiet broken-chord pulse.

presets.title: Baroque counterpoint Ensemble
presets.description: Harpsichord and chamber voices with a steady interlocking percussion companion.

presets.title: Romantic piano Ensemble
presets.description: Piano and warm strings over a soft 3/4 waltz with gentle phrase breathing.

presets.title: Ragtime Ensemble
presets.description: Bright piano and small-band colours with 2/4 bass/chord alternation and syncopation.

presets.title: Funk Ensemble
presets.description: Clavinet, finger bass and guitar with sixteenth-note funk and snare ghosts.

presets.title: Reggae/dub Ensemble
presets.description: Organ, bass and guitar over a spacious one-drop rhythm.

presets.title: Disco/house Ensemble
presets.description: Clavinet, synth bass and strings with four-on-the-floor drums and offbeat hats.

presets.title: Synth-pop Ensemble
presets.description: Saw lead, synth bass and keys with a straight machine backbeat.

presets.title: Synthwave Ensemble
presets.description: Retro lead, rounded synth bass and warm pads with a spacious electronic backbeat.

presets.title: Bossa nova Ensemble
presets.description: Nylon guitar, upright bass and flute with quiet syncopated Brazilian percussion.

presets.title: Drum & bass Ensemble
presets.description: Chiff lead and sub-bass colours with a two-bar drum break at 172 BPM.

presets.title: Afrobeat Ensemble
presets.description: Horns, finger bass and guitar with interlocking Afrobeat percussion.

presets.title: Highlife Ensemble
presets.description: Clean guitar and horns with offbeat timekeeping and a two-bar bell response.

presets.title: Soukous Ensemble
presets.description: Clean guitar-led band with a recurring cavacha-inspired hat figure.

presets.title: Mbalax Ensemble
presets.description: Guitar, bass and brass with sparse sabar-inspired low/high drum responses.

presets.title: Ethio-jazz Ensemble
presets.description: Vibraphone, bass and saxophone with pentatonic colour and a 6/8 jazz companion.

presets.title: Amapiano Ensemble
presets.description: Electric piano and synth bass with soft house drums and low-tom log-drum-like accents.

presets.title: Gnawa-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Plucked-string and bass substitutes for guembri-like colours over a 12-pulse metallic ostinato.

presets.title: Raï-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Accordion, bass and brass with a 4/4 low/high drum accompaniment.

presets.title: Arabic maqam-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Nylon guitar stands in for oud, with violin, wind and Maqsum; the scale is equal-tempered Phrygian.

presets.title: Turkish folk-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Plucked-string and wind substitutes with Karsilama-inspired 9/8 grouped 2+2+2+3.

presets.title: Persian classical-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Dulcimer provides santur-like colour over a metered 6/8 reng-inspired companion; an equal-tempered approximation.

presets.title: Indian raga-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Sitar, flute and reed organ with a 16-beat Tintal companion and a fixed major-scale starting palette.

presets.title: Qawwali-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Reed organ provides harmonium-like colour with choir, clapping and an eight-beat Kaharwa-inspired cycle.

presets.title: Gamelan-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Vibraphone, marimba and bells approximate interlocking metal percussion; the pentatonic scale uses equal temperament.

presets.title: Japanese koto-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Koto and shakuhachi with sparse duple percussion and room for ornament.

presets.title: Chinese guzheng-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: The available koto voice stands in for guzheng, with flute, strings and a quiet measured accompaniment.

presets.title: Korean folk-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Koto approximates gayageum colour, with winds and a Jungjungmori-inspired 12-pulse percussion cycle.

presets.title: Irish jig-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Fiddle, flute and accordion over 6/8 jig timing in two groups of three.

presets.title: Flamenco-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Nylon guitar over a Bulerias-inspired 12-count compas, accented on 12, 3, 6, 8 and 10.

presets.title: Klezmer-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Clarinet, accordion and fiddle with a freylekhs-inspired duple accompaniment.

presets.title: Balkan dance-inspired Ensemble
presets.description: Accordion and clarinet over Rachenitsa-inspired 7/8 grouped 2+2+3.

presets.title: Tango Ensemble
presets.description: Accordion and strings with a habanera-derived 2/4 accompaniment.

presets.title: Argentine tango Ensemble
presets.description: Accordion stands in for bandoneon, with piano and strings over a 3+3+2 rhythmic variant.

presets.title: Samba Ensemble
presets.description: Nylon guitar, bass and brass with alternating muted/open surdo responses.

presets.title: Salsa Ensemble
presets.description: Piano, bass and brass with two-bar 3-2 son clave and tumbao accompaniment.

presets.title: Cumbia Ensemble
presets.description: Accordion, bass and flute with offbeat hand drum and steady shaker.

presets.title: Merengue Ensemble
presets.description: Accordion and saxophone with driving 2/4 scraper and hand-drum responses.

presets.title: Calypso Ensemble
presets.description: Steel pan, bass and guitar with syncopated 2/4 percussion.

presets.title: Soca Ensemble
presets.description: Steel pan, synth bass and brass with a driving kick and offbeat percussion.

presets.title: Bluegrass Ensemble
presets.description: Banjo, upright bass, fiddle and guitar with a light 2/4 bass/chop companion.

presets.title: Rock Ensemble
presets.description: Guitar, pick bass and organ with straight eighths and a firm rock backbeat.

presets.title: Hip-hop Ensemble
presets.description: Electric piano, bass and voice lead with boom-bap timing; hat swing and late snare are built into the pattern.

presets.title: Trap Ensemble
presets.description: Square lead, sub-bass colours and bells with a half-time backbeat and sixteenth-note hats.
